instruction: Format: feed 4:5, 1080x1350. Background: Kapruka Purple #3C096C to #100223. Hero product: gaming console with a controller, placed centrally at 45-55% frame width, resting on a cream plinth #F5F4EB. On-image text: “Explore top gaming consoles” in Inter Black, white #FFFFFF. Support line: “Ultimate playtime awaits in Sri Lanka” in Inter Medium, white #FFFFFF. Lighting: soft, warm light emphasizing the console and controller. NEGATIVE: price tags, discount badges, stars, SHOP NOW buttons, app UI, watermarks, second Kapruka logo, busy patterns.

check.notes: The controller has a visible 'FANTECH' wordmark and logo in the center, and the person appears to be wearing metal watch bands on both wrists.

issues.what: Brand guidelines require Poppins ExtraBold/Bold for headlines and a clear CTA, which is missing here.
issues.fix_in_canva: Verify headline font matches Inter/Poppins rule and add a concise yellow CTA if required by campaign.

issues.what: Kapruka logo top edge sits slightly high near the 110px threshold on the 1080x1350 canvas.
issues.fix_in_canva: Nudge the Kapruka logo down 10-15px to ensure safe clearance within 110px from top.

issues.what: FANTECH wordmark on the controller is slightly soft from AI rendering.
issues.fix_in_canva: Sharpen or overlay a crisp vector FANTECH logo onto the controller center.

strengths: Faithfully recreates reference POV composition, lighting, and TV scene
Accurately swaps in black Fantech Shooter II GP13 controller
Clean white 'GAME ON' headline and Kapruka smile logo
